Has more passion for football than anyone else.
His mighty heart will never give up, no matter what.

Beneath his cool exterior
burns an intense and fiery passion for football.

With his bulky frame, the team's
defence is as sturdy as a wall.

His fancy footwork puts the opposition in their place.
He's nothing short of a gale-force wind sweeping the pitch.

A hothead who cares deeply for his pals.
He seems scary, but behind the scenes, he works incredibly hard.

Raimon's lovable class clown who never
gets out-hustled on guts and grit.

He is a jack-of-all-trades.
In other words, well balanced.

A gifted all-rounder who just
can't stay interested for long.

Darts around the pitch with kung fu flair,
nailing headers with his rock-hard skull.

Often the punchline on Raimon's team,
with hair that shouts louder than he ever does.

Gives off spooky, half-ghost vibes, but all
he really wants is to be noticed.

Self-describing as a popular guy who looks great in glasses,
he may come off as vain, but his Otaku knowledge is the real deal.

An all-rounder once lauded as a genius.
A powerhouse up front and a wall in the back.

Despite his somewhat frivolous nature,
he has a warm heart and genuinely cares for his friends.

A strong and supportive big-sister type who
brought the football club back to life with Mark Evans.

A master of digging up info, her footie
knowledge may rival even Jude's.

A strong-willed young lady. Her dad
will tell you she's a big softy at heart.

The King of Keepers. There is no
angle that he can not cover.

This young giant is capable of
ground-shaking skills.

Lunges for the ball like a mad dog. Size doesn't matter.
Once he's on, he won't let go.

The rhythm from his headphones is
the secret to his strength.

His history and motives are unclear
to all but himself.

Has great pride in the Academy and
looks down on all other teams.

A naturally rough player. He runs
wild on the pitch.

Quick thinker and tricky, like a puzzle box.
Slips through with feints and flair.

Fearless vanguard who charges upfield
and fires explosive shots with his long legs.

A captain who guides his team to victory with precise instructions.
He is an excellent player skilled at both techniques and tactics.

A striker with a deadly shot arsenal and
Jude's ever-reliable right hand.

Physically strong and fast. He can
close down attackers in a second.

Despite not making the team
regularly, his ability is fine.

Being small does not affect his ball
keeping skills.

Making complicated moves look easy
is his forte.
He fires the team up when the heat is on.

Runs Royal Academy with ruthless focus,
ruling both school and club to snatch every win.

Royal Academy teacher turned interim manager,
who stepped up when Ray Dark vanished.

He's the kind of nut who brings
a machete to mow the field.

After a spooky experience, even he
is not sure if he is really alive!

He believes in ghosts and blames
them for everything.

Trying to create life, but
biology is his worst class.

He believes he's invincible, making him
a danger to himself and others.

Although a bit stiff, he disturbs
opponents by flying around them.

As he gets cold easily, he always
keeps well wrapped up.

People say he knows how to invoke
catastrophic curses when angry.

Rumor has it he's psychic, and trains
with the spirits of football legends.

Just a glance at a full moon gives
"Wolf Boy" violent tendencies.

Pale from always doing night
shifts. Loves tomato juice.

Doesn't feel a thing, no matter how
badly injured.

Thinks he was made in a workshop
and has no memories of the past.

He believes in UFOs and watches out
for them every night.

An expert in black magic. He curses
the opposition before every match.

He believes he is not human and
hides behind a mysterious mask.

Occult's mild yet enigmatic manager.
Tick him off and he flips hard.

Officially, the team's long-standing coordinator.
Unofficially, a ghost no one outside knows.
He runs at the ball like a boar to truffles.

Charges repeatedly, just like a
stubborn rooster pecking around.

An expert on marine life, but can't
swim. Often skips swimming classes.

Superb at jumping. His room is full
of frog-related goods.

He doesn't take any back talk and
guards his title as Wild's king.

He is able to steal the ball before
opponents know he is even there.

He catches opponents' movements
with his eagle-eyes.

He may be small, but his acrobatics
put his opponents to shame.

Beats the ball into the goal with
his ape-like size and strength.

Once he has the ball wrapped up,
he doesn't release it.

He can run as fast as a cheetah—
100m in ten seconds flat!

He feels more at home in the
trees than on the ground.

Appears kind and handsome at first
glance, but has a brutal character.

Appreciates good food, even if it
has come straight out of the bin!

Loves cheese. Even eats smelly blue
cheeses that others leave behind!

A complete glutton who goes into
a rage if he runs out of food.

Speaks in jungle roars,
yet somehow teammates understand every word.

A supporter who always rocks fresh scrapes
and loves one-legged flamingo poses.

Follows instructions well, but was
left emotionless after his brainwashing.

Took up football to get famous,
but forgot it all after "conditioning."

His augments make him prone to
losing his will.

Brainwashing implanted fear in him.
He now overreacts to all surprises.

Flaunts the rules with every move
since being brainwashed.

Doesn't mind playing dangerously
since being brainwashed.

Follows instructions religiously
after getting brainwashed.

Plays aggressively close to the
edge since being brainwashed.

This solitary player is made to feel
he's under immense pressure to win.

Brainwashed into believing that his
team's tactics are the best.

Used to be gentle, but became more
aggressive after brainwashing.

Accepted brainwashing to become a
pro and help his poor family.

Brainwashing allowed him to reveal
his true self.

Undertook brainwashing to cheer up
his sick soccer-loving brother.

Thanks to brainwashing, he never
remembers the fouls he commits.

on those who used to belittle him.

every play, every move machine-precise.

His hobby is finding the stars of
the future before they are famous.

Likes model trains and his dream
is to have a roomful some day.

Enjoys cheesy novels and enters
writing competitions every month.

Longs to be a super hero, but only
plays as one in children's games.

Enjoys 'cosplay', but has to make
costumes he can't afford to buy.

Plays online games late at night.
He always sleeps in class.

He can make computers all by
himself. He has over ten at home.

He is passionate about robots. He
gets excited when they are on TV.

A total gamer who's always at the front
of the queue for any new games.

A famous manga artist, he spends
his school days signing books.

Makes a living from winning on
arcade machines.

An avid CB radio enthusiast who
makes them from spare parts.

Regarded as better than the pros
at model figure making.

He always wins fighting games using
the least favorite characters.

He longs to be a voice actor, and likes
to practice by mimicking people.

Never learns from getting viruses
while browsing the internet.

Maid café regular who practically lives there
and invented a watermelon menu item.

Takes to the pitch in full maid attire
to heal tired teammates with her smile.

Reputed as a top keeper, but won't
reveal his face even to his team.

A professional marksman who can
shoot a flea off a dog at 100m.

Gets sick very easily, so he's
never had a chance to shine.

Swears by frog oil for every
injury and swabs it on anyone hurt.

There is nothing he can't steal—
but he only targets the rich.

Gives orders using code words
that only his team understands.

An able ninja, skilled in using smoke
screens to hide his movements.

Climbs like a cat and always lands
on his feet.

A master swordsman who uses an
eye patch to handicap himself.

hence known as the team's key man.

Top-tier ninja who sometimes forgets it's
football and uses his hands.

He used to be a violent ronin, but
found calm through football.

A super jumper, but the higher he
goes, the more likely he is to miss.

He possesses fine ability, but
excels at being a team player.

Puts his ninja experience to use
before every match as a spy.

Skilled at marking opponents and
surrounds them until they give up.

Modern-day ninja who trains players in
secret techniques passed down for generations.

Loves pickles and gets cranky if he
can't eat them at every meal.

bath in front of the fire, even now.

He prefers a toolbox to a regular
bag at school, so stands out a lot.

A true farm-boy, he gets up early
to feed the cows and chickens.

Who needs a mobile? His family just
got a fine rotary-dial house phone.

Maintains his health by drinking
fresh goat milk every day.

Looks after his five brothers
while his parents work the farm.

Hones his willpower by standing in
a waterfall every morning.

A wild child who grew up catching
and cooking his own roast chicken.

Loves being close to nature. Often
seen running barefoot in summer.

Gets to school by trekking across
a whole mountain range every day.

An eccentric type that enjoys
plucking grass to chew.

Only eats farm produce that he and
his family grows.

Can speak to dogs. Often seen
chasing them through the village.

His family is so healthy that even
his great-grandmother is lively.

Loves studying wildlife so much,
he moved to the deep countryside.

Small in stature but steady and sharp,
with a calm heart and a watchful eye.

People think he looks like a wimp
until they see him with a ball.

Erik Eagle's friend from the States.
Fastidious about his hairstyle.

Fashion-forward and trend-obsessed,
his wardrobe changes faster than the scoreboard.

Likes nothing better than a good
sleep...often during school time.

Rock solid and stock still,
he's often mistaken for a statue.

Small but mighty, his insane
vertical leap owns the airspace.

Loves nothing more than a nap on the roof.

No flashy moves or superstar aura,
but his setup instincts are pure gold.

Eldest of three and Kirkwood's captain.
A perfectionist who treats victory as sacred.

Middle brother of the trio. Friendly and approachable,
the team's go-to for venting.

Youngest of three. Looks up to his brothers
and works twice as hard to catch up.

Runs up and down the stairs to his
top-floor flat to train his legs.

A serious player who still broods
over a match he lost 3 years ago.

Was no good at football until he
got his grandad's lucky charm.

Drags his feet when asked to help...
unless it's a girl that's asking.

Practices every day with a football
manual that his father left him.

Kirkwood's manager with scruffy stubble.
He trusts his players and they trust him too.

His fluid, infallible goal-keeping
earned him the nickname "Poseidon."

Warm on the outside, cold killer instinct within.

Tends to hog the spotlight and get carried away,
even in clutch moments.

He looks shy, but can also charge
up the pitch, slaying the opposition.

Unleashes plays like a volcano, roaring down
the pitch and shaking the opposition.

Zeus's sweeper with arrow-like precision.
His passes and shots land as if guided by fate.

Always joking but sharp and strategic,
never ever letting his guard down.

Known as the brain of Zeus Junior High,
so clever some say he channels divine wisdom.

Able to grasp the subtle topography of the pitch
and plays like he's one with the ground he walks on.

Captivating the opposition with artistic grace,
he plays with the aura of a deity from on high.

Burns with jealousy when others steal the spotlight.

He handles the ball in the air
with the grace of a bird in flight.

Possesses amazing strength, but
succumbs easily to ankle injuries.

Strong but uncontrollable. Has
a soft spot for the ladies.

Even without a watch, he always
knows how much game time remains.

His piercing eyes can turn the
opposition to stone.

Gamer turned field warrior.

Once a rowdy brawler, now a team player with a big heart.
Millie's always on his case.

He's always dreaming up new pranks,
which always get him into trouble.

Studies football theory. Known for
asking adults difficult questions.

Loves practice nearly as much as food.
Trains hard, plays harder, snacks hardest.

Worried about his height, he drinks
milk daily to make his bones grow.

A mother's boy who always falters
if his mum isn't in the crowd.

Has pride in his speed and often
attends athletic meets.

Competed on the national junior stage.

He became a footballer by copying
all of his heroes' moves.

Captain of Inazuma Kids FC and still a grade schooler.

can knock them down a peg or two.

No matter what people say, this kid
is two players short of a team.

A cake fiend whose favorite haunt
is an all-you-can-eat cake buffet.

The runt of a family big enough
to make a team of their own.

Loves aeroplanes and dreams of
becoming a pilot one day.

he was once crucial to Inazuma Eleven.

Rumor has it that this mysterious figure who
lives by the riverbank is quite the big deal.

A hair salon owner who instinctively
gives players a crew-cut.

A dependable man who looks after
the whole neighborhood.

The Raimon family butler. Has looked
after Nelly since she was born.

Likes a regular life and working
for a regular company.

Always shouting "How rude!" at
people wherever he goes.

A bespoke tailor who believes
only in fitted suits.

A café owner who dreamt about
being a singer when he was younger.

A student guidance teacher who
used to need guidance himself.

A personal trainer whose body is
twenty years younger than his age.

A university professor who uses such
difficult words, nobody can understand him.

A martial arts teacher known for
breaking down his opponents.

high-stakes on football matches.

strength with char-grilled meat.

has a joke to lighten the mood.

before a match.

Loves exercise so much, his home
is practically a gym.

He's always willing to lend anyone
a hand with heavy luggage.

before every match.

Practices in car parks at night,
using headlights for floodlights.

Trains his balance by practicing on
a unicycle he got in primary school.

Keeps up to date on world football
using football sites and magazines.

Always seen running around helping
out at his parents' restaurant.

Turned to football after hurting
his wrist playing semi-pro tennis.

given the nickname "Cyborg."

Believes his tactics will—once
perfected—revolutionize football.

Not a team player, but good at
smoothing over ruffled feathers.

He is unable to succeed at anything
without his parents' advice.

A real football maniac. He eats,
sleeps and breathes football.

compensates with a big personality.

Manager of Umbrella Football Club, a calm
presence who puts even nervous players at ease.

A greengrocing gran who's good at
keeping vegetables and footballs.

extra helpings at her restaurant.

years as a chiropractor.

An experienced doctor whose only
flaw is a lack of self-confidence.

shoppers, browsers and ageism.

at the local chamber of commerce.

children and stray dogs.

A pub owner who drinks more beers

A CD shop owner who prefers to talk
about music instead of selling his wares.

At home, he adores his family,
but secretly he prefers football.

He loves the theatre so much that
he always sits in the front row.

football-shaped loaf at his bakery.

A keen inventor who once made
shoes with springs. (They flew off.)

Only in the team to make up the
numbers. Oblivious to the rules.

Dreams of being a sports
commentator like his father.

Axel's little sister, hospitalized after an accident.

up football to get noticed by the girls.

A Raimon student, whose kind nature
has garnered her a secret fanclub.

Runs blindingly fast.

"yellow cards" from his teachers.

One of the Junior League's Four Emperors.

A dark horse who's always happy
if he gets noticed for a change.

He floats like a butterfly whenever
he gets on the pitch.

tunnel vision when he concentrates.

Excels in a straight sprint,
but useless if he has to turn.

with how much he sweats.

his father's love of baseball.

An expert in laboriously rounding up
information on opposing teams.

His years as a high jumper gave him
the ability to jump like a rocket.

His voice booms like thunder,
so his friends often use earplugs.

He may be small and light, but he

protect his hands. Feels weird without them.

a master at shielding the ball.

he has to buy it.

gelling his trademark spiky hair.

but clams up in front of girls.

His dream is to have one of his
sports photos published one day.

Stubborn as a mule. Once he makes
his mind up, he won't change it.

He's always first to get to school,
but it's a mystery why...

he takes up the family business.

clubs, so he's always busy.

Usually dormant, but prone to
explosive bouts of rage.

rock, paper, scissors in his life.
